facts.business: Frontline Financial Services Limited is engaged in trading of construction materials including Ready Mix Concrete (RMC) and provides financial and management consultancy services.

auditor.name: J.S Shah and Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Disclaimer of opinion due to unconfirmed balances of sundry creditors, debtors, loans and advances, deposits, current liabilities, unsecured loans; lack of documentation for investment in plot and premises at Sanand; inability to verify inventory valuation and quantity; and lack of bank confirmation for Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd account. Also noted absence of adequate internal controls over related party transactions and non-maintenance of proper fixed asset records.

key_risks: Bullish trend in equity markets, commodities and real estate may affect volume and profitability of Government Securities business
Changes in rate of interest may affect company's profitability
Unconfirmed balances of sundry creditors, debtors, loans and advances, deposits, current liabilities and unsecured loans
Lack of documentation for investment in plot and premises at Sanand
Inadequate inventory records and inability to physically verify inventory
Absence of bank confirmation for Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd account
Absence of adequate internal controls over identification, approval, documentation and recording of related party transactions
Non-maintenance of proper fixed asset records and lack of physical verification of property, plant and equipment
facts.related_party_note: Auditors unable to express opinion on compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 due to absence of adequate internal controls over identification, approval, documentation and recording of related party transactions, and absence of sufficient appropriate audit evidence.
